description: Guernsey replaced its traditional census with a register-based Electronic Census run by the States of Guernsey Data and Analysis team, which also publishes an annual report on the island's housing stock. The Residential Property Stock Report 2025 counts 27,799 domestic property units at 31 December 2025, of which 1,607 are open market, and breaks them down by type, bedrooms, tax band, tenure and ownership, vacancy and specialised housing, and by parish, with 9,096 units in St Peter Port at 1,418 units per square kilometre. Its data come from several States services combined in a spatial system from Digimap and run back to 2010. The Electronic Census page adds a spreadsheet at postcode level for March 2023 with the number of people, dwelling type counts and flags for age, employment and cars per adult. Coverage is national for the island of Guernsey. Format and access: free PDF and XLSX downloads, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the stock report is a PDF with tables and maps; the postcode file suppresses small postcodes and gives above or below average flags, not values. Simulation uses: housing density and dwelling type by parish, and car ownership by postcode. Related records: none for Guernsey in the catalogue.

schema_summary: Stock report sections 2 to 8: domestic property units by market (local or open), type (house or bungalow, apartment, other), bedrooms, tax on real property band, tenure and ownership, parish and density per square kilometre, annual units created and removed, vacant units and specialised housing. Postcode spreadsheet: postcode, number of people, above-average flags for age groups, employment status and cars per adult, count of domestic addresses by type (apartment, house and others); postcodes with fewer than five people or addresses are excluded.
